pageState.description: Read the current Instagram route, authentication gate, challenge, rate-limit, and hydration state.

returns.description: Current Instagram page state.

searchState.description: Verify that Instagram reached an active keyword search surface and distinguish results, an explicit empty state, and login or challenge gates.

returns.description: Search route, query, gate, and result state.

openSearch.description: Locate the homepage Search control (magnifying glass) so the host can open the account suggestion panel. Returns already_open when the search input is visible.

returns.description: Search-control geometry, or already_open when the input is visible.

accountSuggestions.description: Read Instagram account suggestions from the open search dropdown, in visual order. Does not open profiles or follow anyone.

returns.description: Ordered account suggestions, or an explicit empty or gate state.

setSearchQuery.description: Set a query in the visible Instagram search input and dispatch input events; this never follows, likes, comments, or sends messages.

returns.description: Whether the visible search input accepted the query.

clickResult.description: Locate one Instagram search-grid card by shortcode and return the center of its visible video or image for a native click. Does not navigate.

returns.description: Click target geometry.

commentState.description: Read whether the open Instagram overlay has mounted comments and a playable video URL. Used to avoid closing the overlay before those regions hydrate.

returns.description: Comment count, explicit empty state, and video URL readiness.

closeOverlay.description: Locate the visible Close control on the current Instagram post overlay.

returns.description: Close-control geometry, or a miss when none is visible.

searchResults.description: Collect Instagram profile, hashtag, location, post, or reel search candidates across lazy-scroll pages up to limit.

viewport_only.description: Only include results intersecting the viewport.

returns.description: Visible Instagram search candidates.

scrollResults.description: Scroll an Instagram search surface by one bounded viewport step to hydrate more candidates.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

to_top.description: Reset the search surface to the top.

returns.description: Search scroll and candidate-count state.

profileDetail.description: Extract the active Instagram profile, biography, visible counts, external URL, and canonical identity.

returns.description: Visible Instagram profile details or an explicit gate state.

profilePosts.description: Collect post and reel cards across the active Instagram profile's lazy grid up to limit.

limit.description: Maximum post or reel cards to return.

viewport_only.description: Only include cards intersecting the viewport.

returns.description: Visible Instagram profile posts and reels.

scrollPosts.description: Scroll an Instagram profile grid by one bounded step to hydrate more posts and reels.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

to_top.description: Reset the profile grid to the top.

returns.description: Profile-grid scroll, post-count, and end-of-list state.

postCardTarget.description: Locate an Instagram post or Reel card and return geometry for a trusted native click without invoking its anchor navigation.

returns.description: Card identity and click-target geometry.

postOpenState.description: Verify that the expected Instagram post or Reel opened and report login, challenge, or rate-limit gates.

returns.description: Open-post identity and gate state.

closePostTarget.description: Locate the close control for an Instagram post dialog so the native host can click it and return to the originating list.

returns.description: Close-control geometry or an explicit absence state.

postDetail.description: Extract the active Instagram post or reel, caption, author, media, publication time, and visible engagement metadata.

returns.description: Visible Instagram post details or an explicit gate state.

comments.description: Collect comments and expanded replies across the active Instagram post or reel up to limit; never likes, replies, or submits anything.

returns.description: Accumulated, deduplicated Instagram comments.

scrollComments.description: Load the next bounded batch of Instagram comments and collapsed replies using read-only expansion controls.

returns.description: Comment growth, expansion, and end-of-list state.

commentEditorTarget.description: Inspect the verified active post and return owned pointer geometry for its visible comment editor; never focuses or types.

shortcode.description: Expected active post or Reel shortcode.

returns.description: Fail-closed comment editor geometry bound to the active post.

commentDraftState.description: Read the draft and focus state of the verified active post comment editor.

shortcode.description: Expected active post or Reel shortcode.

returns.description: Current comment draft state bound to the active post.

commentSubmitTarget.description: Inspect the verified editor scope and return owned pointer geometry for its enabled Post control; never clicks.

shortcode.description: Expected active post or Reel shortcode.

returns.description: Fail-closed Post control geometry bound to the active editor.

renderedCommentState.description: Count exact rendered comment text inside the verified active post for one-shot reconciliation.

shortcode.description: Expected active post or Reel shortcode.

returns.description: Exact rendered comment count for reconciliation.
